0.content: After the Spirit Seeker preview, with the blizzard worsening, Dymov proposes fetching blankets from a nearby inn so people can wrap up for the way home. He asks them to return the blankets next time they pass, and runs off. When Torgov and Shram later ask why he has not come back, the group hopes he gave up and went home. The Traveler's later reasoning treats this moment as the beginning of the incident, with Alyosha the second to walk into the storm to look for him.
